# darce.xyz
> Portfolio and case studies for Daniel Arcé.
> Daniel Arcé works across interaction design and front-end development, using working software to explore how people find information and act on it.

## Pages
- / — Home
- /work/ — Index of project case studies
- /about/ — Bio, role focus, strengths
- /research/ — Index of technical writing and experiments

## Projects
- /projects/visual-search-workbench/ — Search your photo folders by words or an example image, then explore related pictures on a UMAP map. Processing stays on the Mac.
- /projects/altcontext/ — AltContext combines a photograph with a publisher’s named people roster and page context. Editors review the proposed identity and wording before applying the text in WordPress.
- /projects/photoshelter/ — R&D prototyping that cut downstream implementation effort by an internal estimate of roughly 30%, and WCAG 2.1 audit and remediation on contracts worth a combined $9.2M ARR that were exposed if compliance could not be demonstrated, across a media platform serving 80,000+ users and 1B+ files.
- /projects/msnbc/ — Helped take MSNBC’s dedicated video experience from initial product definition through functional prototypes, interaction design, production development, and an on-schedule launch.
- /projects/workbay/ — WorkBay records tasks, decisions, review findings, and test evidence in the repository. Later sessions can retrieve the record across supported AI coding tools.
- /projects/apple/ — Built launch-critical landing pages, a CSS-animated email campaign, and internal workflow tooling for Apple’s iPhone X release
- /projects/barbarabeirne/ — Recovered a photography archive from a defunct Flash site, rebuilt the portfolio, and later rewrote the live site with Web Components
- /projects/bauhausdances/ — Designed a visual identity rooted in the film’s source material and built a custom WordPress theme with self-hosted video

## Research
- /research/visual-search-workbench-process/ — How Visual Search Workbench connects search, a UMAP map, and an image grid to help people explore a photo collection and develop a visual direction.
- /research/visual-search-workbench-screen-reference/ — An interaction reference for Visual Search Workbench: begin with words or a picture, follow similar images, and inspect a UMAP map selection in the image grid.
- /research/agent-memory/ — WorkBay separates the stored project record from the retrieval layer that finds it and the context packet a coding session reads.
- /research/interrogating-agent-memory/ — Five recurring questions show how I use WorkBay’s project record to examine an earlier decision before making the next one.
- /research/economics-of-agent-memory/ — An audit snapshot describes WorkBay context packets. A proposed paired comparison tests whether they reduce task token use without lowering quality.
- /research/heuristics-canon/ — Heuristics Canon gives design, engineering, and writing reviews specific triggers and questions, with references that let another reviewer examine the reasoning.
- /research/rotation-matrices/ — A browser experiment that makes rotation matrices and perspective projection, normally abstracted by WebGL, visible using only TypeScript, DOM elements, and CSS transforms
- /research/order-book/ — An interactive guide to bids, asks, spread, and visible market depth using live Binance WebSocket data
